sloka: एष्टव्या बहव: पुत्रा गुणवन्तो बहुश्रुता: ।तेषां वै समवेतानामपि कश्चिद्गयां व्रजेत् ॥ २.१०७.१३॥
transliteration: eṣṭavyā bahava: putrā guṇavanto bahuśrutā: ।teṣāṁ vai samavetānāmapi kaścidgayāṁ vrajet ॥ 2.107.13॥

translations.english: One should desire many virtuous and learned sons so that at least one of them may go to Gaya (to perform the father's obsequies).
